name: StdFeedback
description: High-performance Telegram Feedback, Support & Contact Bot built in Go with MongoDB persistence, anonymous ticketing, clone support, and real-time admin replies.

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram Numeric User ID of the Bot Owner

MONGO_URI.description: MongoDB Connection String (MongoDB Atlas or standalone)

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Telegram Channel ID for audit and feedback logs (e.g. -1001234567890)

AUTH_USERS.description: Space-separated User IDs of authorized admins/sudo users
